listing.name: Muppet RaceMania — RustMania Racing (Ray-m-w)
listing.summary: Race with the Muppets in RustMania Racing using your own supported USA PlayStation disc image.

steps.title: Keep the original disc image separate
steps.instruction: Use your own USA Muppet RaceMania disc (SLUS-01237) as a supported CUE with its matching BIN, or the track BIN. Convert CHD upstream before Play. Keep the files at a stable location outside the runtime. The engine reads them during play and can warn about a nonmatching track digest.

steps.title: Prepare an external copy if you want custom paths
steps.instruction: Use the complete official Windows x64 package. Upstream specifies Windows 10 or 11 and a GPU with Vulkan or Direct3D 12. In an external copy, use the in-game disc prompt. Back up the actual AppData profile or your chosen data directory before replacing it.

warnings: Gameplay and real save compatibility remain unverified. Keep the original disc image and back up any existing save separately.

data_locations: the actual %APPDATA%/MuppetRaceMania profile, portable or custom profile, and the external original disc image

preparation.title: Choose your own Muppet RaceMania USA disc image
preparation.instruction: Choose Play. If no readable disc is configured, enter the full path to your own supported disc image in the game window. Keep the disc files outside the Portcove runtime. Choose a path without # so the game can remember it in its profile.

warnings: This runtime starts with a separate profile and does not import your external AppData progress. If its profile folder cannot be created, the engine can write beside the player. Portcove preserves the declared fallback files as well. Use a prepared copy for custom paths. Runtime rollback does not establish save compatibility.
